title: INT-CORE-ingested track (NVG)
description: Published BY bridges/intcore_bridge.py via protocols.gateway.publish_dual() to {TOPIC_ROOT}/{domain}/intcore/c2/{aff}/{entity}/{id}/tracks/v1, decoded from an INT-CORE NVG 2.0 <point> element (KML->NVG transform), plus sibling .../proto/tracks/v1 and .../sapient/tracks/v1 views — this schema documents the JSON leg. domain/aff/entity are slugged from the point's own symbol code by sidc_to_topic() — only app6x:/sidc: schemes are trusted as real SIDC; flag:/icon: symbols fall back to unknown/unit routing. The parsed SIDC itself is not stored on the track (transient, topic-routing only) — see target_type below for what SAPIENT actually reads.

_ts.description: The NVG point's own <TimeStamp> when present and parseable; otherwise the bridge's own receipt time.

_src.description: Fixed source tag identifying this bridge.

_ingress.description: Marks this track as having entered via the INT-CORE path specifically.

uid.description: Decoded from the point's uri attribute (URL-unquoted, last ':'-segment). Omitted, not empty, when uri was absent.

callsign.description: From the point's label attribute. Omitted when absent.

alt_m.description: From the point's z attribute (already meters). Omitted when absent/unparseable.

speed_ms.description: From the point's speed attribute, converted from knots (NVG data.xsd unit) via *0.514444. Omitted when absent/unparseable.

heading_deg.description: From the point's course attribute, degrees as-is (not normalized to [0,360) unlike sitaware_track). Omitted when absent/unparseable.

target_type.description: Derived from the same parsed SIDC via entity_type_for_sidc() (aircraft/unit/vessel/satellite) — feeds flex335.py's _classification_for() for the SAPIENT view. Unlike sitaware_track, there is no raw sidc field here to compare it against (see note above); this is the only classification signal this producer carries.
